subject: Global timebox deconflict for hands-on deep dive (US/EU/APAC)
messages:
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>
To: Samantha Jones <samantha.jones@edgecloud.io>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Dev Patel <dev.patel@redwood.ai>
Date: Sat, 20 Feb 2027 09:15:00 -0800
Subject: Global timebox deconflict for hands-on deep dive (US/EU/APAC)

Hi Samantha and Tom —

Thanks again for agreeing to a hands-on deep dive for the EdgeCloud POC. We want to make the sessions as useful as possible for your engineers: prompt review, routing architecture walkthrough, and a short load-rehearsal focused on steady-state throughput and KV/cache behavior. Because teams are distributed across time zones, I wanted to propose a rotating timebox so we can include your US, EU, and APAC engineers across the week without everyone staying late every day.

Proposed rotating windows (each session ~90 minutes):
- US-friendly window: Mon 17:00–18:30 PT / Tue 01:00–02:30 UTC
- EU-friendly window: Tue 09:00–10:30 CET / Tue 08:00–09:30 UTC
- APAC-friendly window: Thu 09:00–10:30 IST / Thu 03:30–05:00 UTC

Initial plan:
- Day 1: Prompt & prompt-eval review (owner: Marissa)
- Day 2: Routing design + KV/cache warmup (owner: Dev)
- Day 3: Load rehearsal (light load then ramp, owner: Karthik)

Attachments: Ive attached a working agenda and a short network checklist for the load test (POC-Agenda-v2.pdf, network-checklist.xlsx). Can you confirm whether these windows look reasonable for your team, and if there are blackout dates we should avoid? Also let me know if you want the load rehearsal to target a particular token/sec target or scenario.

If those slots dont work we can propose alternatives, but wed prefer to lock in a rotating pattern so we can schedule internal leads and do a dry-run.

Thanks —
Karthik Iyer
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
karthik.iyer@redwood.ai | +1 415-555-0126

- EU engineering lead (Tom) prefers mid-morning CET — Tue 09:00 CET works well.
- Our Seattle team is partially distributed; US-friendly window on Mon 17:00 PT could be tight for a couple of folks. If we do rotating windows then Mon (US) as an evening slot is acceptable once every two weeks.
- APAC: our Singapore engineers are available Thu mornings IST/SGT but they will need a 1-week heads-up for any load rehearsals (network changes require ops coordination).

For the load rehearsal, can we target a nominal 250 tok/s sustained for 10 minutes as the first ramp? We'll iterate.

Let us know final slots and we will circulate invites internally.
